name: Discrete Diode — SolderJumper
description: Cluster of 7 surface-mount discrete diode components in the SolderJumper package family featuring open, bridged, and bridged 2-bar pad footprints.
selection_hints: Select matching SolderJumper footprint variant such as open, bridged, or bridged 2-bar configurations.
Choose appropriate pad geometry including standard, rounded, or triangle pad options.
Verify footprint pitch of 1.3 mm and pad dimensions of 1.0x1.5 mm.
avoid_when: The application requires through-hole components rather than surface-mount parts.
A package layout other than 2-pin SolderJumper with 1.3 mm pitch is required.
Components verified above quality tier C or with planner visibility are required.
